about_the_game:
Fallout RPG - Hunted

Traveling the wasteland comes with many hazards, some of which are not entirely of this world. In this digital adventure for 
Fallout: The Roleplaying Game , you will face one such otherworldly threat.

A storm forces you to take shelter in a location held by Raiders but, before the storm can pass, events go from bad to worse as a terrifying creature makes its lethal presence known. Tracking the unusual predator to a nearby Atomatoys factory brings you into contact with a gang of brutish Super Mutants who have also suffered attacks from the same creature. The climax of the quest is a deadly game of cat-and-mouse through the factory as you hunt the creature to ultimately decide which is the predator and which is the prey.

The  Hunted
 product features:

<ul> <li> Adapted from a 17-page adventure in three acts for character levels 11-16.</li>
<li> Negotiate with Raiders and Super Mutants!</li>
<li> Investigate the abandoned Atomatoys Factory!</li>
<li> Hunt (and be hunted by) a strange and deadly creature!</li>
</ul>
This product requires the core rules found in the Fallout: The Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook

 
but could be played using the rules and pregen characters found in the Fallout: The Roleplaying Game Starter Set .

"
